title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Opera House on 1970-10-24
lineage: Transfer:  low gen Reel > Technics RS-1506 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC > WaveLab 5 > .wav 24-bit/96k - transferred by Matt Smith
source: Unknown mono soundboard (low gen) - provided by Will Boswell

ai_review.summary: Adequate recording captures a spectacular Jerry‑fronted NRPS performance and solid Dead numbers, though the setlist documentation needs fixing.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the tape for showcasing Jerry Garcia’s relaxed, on‑the‑groove playing with New Riders of the Purple Sage and notes that the audio is sufficient to hear both ensembles clearly. While the sound quality is described as merely adequate, the performance itself is highlighted as spectacular, despite missing setlist details.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it lauds the musical performance but calls the recording only adequate, leading to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer says the recording is 'adequate' – clear enough to hear the band ensemble and Jerry's playing, but no mention of high‑fidelity soundboard or audience ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set includes a NRPS segment followed by a Dead set with several repeats (e.g., Not Fade Away) and some missing songs; overall performance is praised despite the confusing documentation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Spectacular, relaxed, and on his game; his playing is highlighted as the main attraction.
